==== derivedInterfaceIncompatibleWithBaseIndexer.tlua (5 errors) ====
    -- ported from tests/cases/conformance/interfaces/interfaceDeclarations/derivedInterfaceIncompatibleWithBaseIndexer.ts
    -- dropped: @target: es2015 directive (tlua defaults to latest target)
    -- note: a Lua number key `1` and a string key `"1"` are distinct keys, so each
    --   member is checked against exactly one applicable index signature -- the
    --   number indexer for `1`, the string indexer for `"1"`. Upstream JavaScript
    --   canonicalizes numeric names to strings and therefore checks numeric-looking
    --   members against both indexers, which is why upstream reports seven errors
    --   and tlua reports five. For the same reason the two `Derived5` declarations
    --   merge into two distinct members here rather than one.
    
    interface Base {
        [x: number]: { x: number; y: number; };
        [x: string]: { x: number; }
    }
    
    interface Derived extends Base {
        1: { y: number } -- error
        ~
!!! error TLUA2411: Property '1' of type '{ y: number; }' is not assignable to 'number' index type '{ x: number; y: number; }'.
    }
    
    interface Derived2 extends Base {
        "1": { y: number } -- error
        ~~~
!!! error TLUA2411: Property '"1"' of type '{ y: number; }' is not assignable to 'string' index type '{ x: number; }'.
    }
    
    interface Derived3 extends Base {
        foo: { y: number } -- error
        ~~~
!!! error TLUA2411: Property 'foo' of type '{ y: number; }' is not assignable to 'string' index type '{ x: number; }'.
    }
    
    interface Derived4 extends Base {
        foo(): { x: number } -- error
        ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2411: Property 'foo' of type '() => { x: number; }' is not assignable to 'string' index type '{ x: number; }'.
    }
    
    -- satisifies string indexer but not numeric indexer
    interface Derived5 extends Base {
        1: { x: number } -- error
        ~
!!! error TLUA2411: Property '1' of type '{ x: number; }' is not assignable to 'number' index type '{ x: number; y: number; }'.
    }
    
    interface Derived5 extends Base {
        "1": { x: number } -- ok in tlua: the string key is only checked against the string indexer
    }
